# Action catalog

Every capability this build can dispatch, grouped by the CLI root it runs under. Read a block to
decide WHICH capability a request wants; the `pick it` line is the one written for that
decision.

## Before deciding a capability is missing

default     ow_add, ow_corpora, ow_open, ow_query
full        ow_add, ow_corpora, ow_coverage, ow_diff, ow_doctor, ow_explain, ow_grid, ow_open,
            ow_query

an unlisted tool is DEFINED and DISPATCHABLE when enabled, never refused for being unlisted.
Widen with OMNIWEAVE_MCP_LISTED, authorise with OMNIWEAVE_MCP_ENABLED.

Every tool below also has a CLI twin, which runs whatever the listing says. If a route needs a
capability the client does not offer, the twin is the route.

## ow add

### ow_add

action      add
cli         ow add
listed      default, full
cost        billed_api
pick it     the answer is not indexed yet
it does     Index files, directories or URLs into a corpus so ow_query can cite them; billable
            work defers with the command that approves it

## ow corpora

### ow_corpora

action      corpora
cli         ow corpora
listed      default, full
cost        free
pick it     you do not know what exists yet
it does     List what this server can read and what is in each corpus: counts, formats, known
            gaps, freshness and the capability floor

### ow_coverage

action      corpus.coverage
cli         ow corpora
listed      full
cost        free
pick it     ow_query said absent and you need to know why
it does     What a scope holds and what is missing from it: discovered against indexed, the gap
            list behind a low or absent verdict, and the command that clears each gap

## ow doc

### ow_diff

action      doc.diff
cli         ow doc diff
listed      full
cost        free
pick it     the document was re-indexed and you need what moved
it does     Compare two generations of one document: what carried, what was revised, what is
            new, and whether the newer generation was quarantined rather than committed

### ow_grid

action      doc.grid
cli         ow doc grid
listed      full
cost        free
pick it     you hold a table cite and need cells, not prose
it does     Read one table as an exactly-once grid: every cell at its slot, the header row and
            column, and the merges that would otherwise be counted twice

## ow doctor

### ow_doctor

action      doctor
cli         ow doctor
listed      full
cost        free
pick it     something is misconfigured and you need the command
it does     Check this deployment: every resolved configuration value with its source, the
            driver and toolchain probes, and a fix command for every warning

## ow explain

### ow_explain

action      explain
cli         ow explain
listed      full
cost        free
pick it     you have a code from an error and need what clears it
it does     Resolve an OW-* code or symbol to what it means and the exact command that clears
            it; reads no corpus, so it answers on a machine with no store at all

## ow open

### ow_open

action      open
cli         ow open
listed      default, full
cost        free
pick it     you have an id, not a question
it does     Fetch the exact passages behind an address you already hold: a cite, a page range,
            or a whole document

## ow query

### ow_query

action      query
cli         ow query
listed      default, full
cost        local_compute
pick it     you have a question, not an id
it does     Ask an indexed corpus a question and get cited passages, a verdict, and the gaps
            that could be hiding an answer
